assistant.title: AI assistant
assistant.subtitle: Ask anything about your property or about MulkCare services.
assistant.demoNotice: No AI provider is connected in this build. Replies are pre-written to explain how the app works, and no booking, price or confirmation is ever generated.
assistant.attachNotice: Attachments are not configured in this build.
assistant.failed: The message could not be sent. Nothing was sent.
assistant.emptyBody: Pick a suggested question or type your own.
assistant.clearConfirmBody: Every message in this session will be deleted.
assistant.q1: How do I report an air-conditioning problem?
assistant.q2: How can I prepare my property before arrival?
assistant.q3: How do I view my latest inspection report?
assistant.q4: How can I request a cleaning service?
assistant.demo_ac: Open Services → choose the Air conditioning category → select the property → describe the problem → pick a date and time → submit. The request appears in the tracking list as Pending, and when an estimate arrives it moves to Awaiting approval. Work never starts before you approve.
assistant.demo_cleaning: In Services choose the Cleaning category, select the property and describe what you need (a full clean or pre-arrival preparation), then submit. You can also tap “Request cleaning” on the dashboard to reach the same form.
assistant.demo_report: From the dashboard, the “Latest inspection summaries” section opens the report. You can also open Property details → Inspection reports. The report shows the overall condition, per-category checklist results, inspector notes, photos, and recommendations kept separate from the findings.
assistant.demo_prep: Pre-arrival preparation is part of the Premium plan: the home is cleaned and set up before you arrive. Subscriptions compares both plans, and Services is where you send a preparation request with your arrival date.
assistant.demo_invoice: Every invoice and expense appears under Account → Invoices, with the line description, amount and payment status. The invoices here are sample data, not real charges.
assistant.demo_plan: Subscriptions lists the Basic and Premium plans with included services, inspection frequency and service limits. The prices shown are proposed test prices, and choosing a plan only sends a request to the team — there is no online payment in this build.
assistant.demo_default: I am a demo assistant in this build and I am not connected to any AI provider, so I cannot book, quote or confirm anything. I can explain how the app works: requesting a service, tracking a request, reading an inspection report, preparing your home, invoices, or choosing a plan. Try a word like “air conditioning”, “cleaning” or “report”.
